name: Privatzimmer Panorama
beschreibung: The Gasthof Panorama is located on the outskirts of Thiersee, a village in the Tiroler Unterland near the Bavarian border. The house offers guest rooms with a view of the surrounding forests and mountains. Guests will find simple, traditional furnishings – typical of a Tiroler Gasthof. A small breakfast is served in the morning. The location is ideal as a starting point for hikes and circular lake walks at Thiersee.
